$uid..validate: newData.hasChildren(['uid','domain','reason','createdAt']) && newData.child('uid').val() === auth.uid && newData.child('domain').isString() && newData.child('domain').val().length > 2 && newData.child('domain').val().length <= 253 && newData.child('reason').isString() && (newData.child('reason').val() === 'impersonation' || newData.child('reason').val() === 'credential_theft' || newData.child('reason').val() === 'investment_scam' || newData.child('reason').val() === 'malware' || newData.child('reason').val() === 'other') && newData.child('createdAt').isNumber() && newData.child('createdAt').val() <= now + 60000 && newData.child('createdAt').val() >= now - 86400000

$deviceKey..validate: newData.hasChildren(['uid','createdAt']) && newData.child('uid').val() === auth.uid && newData.child('createdAt').isNumber() && newData.child('createdAt').val() <= now + 60000 && newData.child('createdAt').val() >= now - 86400000
